device.board: 0A050800 (Edision / Fulansoft ALi M3606C dual-tuner Lemontree EuP platform)
device.soc: ALi M3606C / C3603 (bootloader "M3606c 1.1.3", seecode "M3606 SEE"; Libcore 7.24.0@SDK4.0ba.7.24_SAB_20130620)
device.demod: ALi S3501 DVB-S2 on SCB0 at I2C 0x33
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 DVB-S2 on SCB0 at I2C 0x60

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Edision firmware archive)
source.author: Edision / Fulansoft
source.note: Archive Edision.vip3.0A050800_emu_1.6.60.rar from the Edison directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-10-31.

simulator.note: Boots as an M3602-family board with chip ID 0x3603 (C3603, chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_vip3_app_starts.py, run_dump_vip3_capture_screen.py): under 0x3603 the "M3606c 1.1.3" bootloader maps the 8 MB flash in the 16 MB window at 0xAF000000, prints "APP  init ok", parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1E8F9B8, exchanges CRC-16/XMODEM frames (" ON " -> "    ") with the Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit LED microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged GPIO 103 (SCL) / 102 (SDA), and unpacks maincode(AV) to 0x80000200.  The application starts "M3606 SEE" at 0xA7000200 (EBase 0x80000000 / 0x80000001), updates the Lemontree panel to " on ", configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60 ("stb_tuner_type = 1, stb_board_type =7."), and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog (8 GE commands, 4 colours; without the board's anti-clone IDENT IC at SCB0 I2C 0x20 it shows "IDENT Error --UNINIT!").

desc: Edision Argus VIP3 (System ID 0A050800) firmware 1.6.60 EMU (2015-02-15) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the dual-tuner pluggable ALi M3606C / C3603 Full HD receiver with 2x CA, 2x CI and Ethernet.

Pairs dual-CPU M3606 maincode + seecode ("M3606 SEE" at 0xA7000200) with a Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit LED MCU at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged GPIO 103 / 102 (" ON " -> " on "), ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60.
